name: freerouter
description: Free, self-hosted AI model router — smart routing with your own API keys (OpenRouter alternative)

scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:security: for f in sigv4 oidc policy egress endpoints metrics resilience balance secllm-intake azure mcp-protocol mcp-policy mcp-gateway; do npx tsx test/security/$f.test.ts || exit 1; done
scripts.test:integration: for f in e2e admin; do npx tsx test/security/$f.test.ts || exit 1; done
